nodes.label: A domain vocabulary is a pack of the registry; the engine ships its own vocabulary and no other
nodes.summary: A domain vocabulary is a pack of the registry, released there and installed per project like any pack; the engine ships exactly one vocabulary, `oto-core`, which is its own schema (the temporal fields, `Document`, `Tool`, `Graph`) and not a domain, and the nine domain vocabularies it ships today move to Cynergis/oto-registry, the seven the registry already carries republished from the engine's current releases and `architecture` and `portfolio` published for the first time.
